summary: Off-registry HTTPS dependency source enables install-time code execution
details: package.json at line 12 declares its sole dependency `cache-format-syntax-tracer` as a bare HTTPS URL to `https://artifacts.creditslib.com/npm/cache-format-syntax-tracer` instead of a registry version range. On `npm install`, npm fetches whatever bytes that URL returns and installs them, with no version pin and no integrity hash, running any lifecycle scripts contained in the fetched tarball on the installer's machine. The package's own shipped code is a thin re-export of that dependency, so install- and import-time behavior are entirely defined by the content served from the external host. The host `artifacts.creditslib.com` is not associated with the declared `@flexmr` publisher scope, and the dependency name does not correspond to a registry-resolvable package, giving the shape of a dependency-confusion lure whose only effect on install is to pull in attacker-controlled code.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
